provenance.authors: Andrej Dujella and Juan Carlos Peral
provenance.paper: Elliptic curves induced by Diophantine triples
provenance.published_claim: At v=5 the six displayed sections are independent; the Gusić–Tadić criterion proves exact generic rank 6 and torsion C2 × C2.
provenance.sign_audit: Original paper equation (8) has x6 with coefficient +9. A later survey reprint shows -9; exact curve membership at v=5 confirms +9.
provenance.omitted_variant_reason: §2.6 states that these three base changes also produce rank-6 curves but intentionally omits the two additional section formulas; they are retained as research leads, not release variants.
provenance.release_claim_boundary: Rank Hunter operationally certifies the generic lower bound 6 at v=5; the paper's exact generic-rank theorem remains provenance metadata.

pipeline_search.strategy_note: Exact rank-6 baseline plus plugin-local ratpoints; core owns independence and promotion.
